notes.title: Game Studio Discord
notes.content:
With the celebration of pursuing a career within game development I've decided to set up a [url=https://discord.gg/bakDssQ3xx]Discord server[/url]. Join link: https://discord.gg/bakDssQ3xx

Now this discord will be for my game studios, so i'll be posting any kinds of updates regarding any game that i am in the midst of making but it can also be used if you want to chat about Cubey Quarry ^^

I appreciate all the feedback I've either had through reviews or discussions on the forum, and have made quite a few changes thanks to that, so this is another way to get in contact.

With that being said thank you guys so much for trying out my game, it's almost unbelievable that I'm nearing 3000 who has played the game, I hope to see you in the next as well, until then take care and have a good one <3
